verdict.rationale: First-party docs say incidents can be declared, run, and resolved from Slack, Google Chat, and Microsoft Teams. Workflows automatically create the incident channel in Slack or Teams and update stakeholders, and in-channel commands like `/rootly summary` support running the incident from chat. Community comments independently confirm the Slack-centric workflow. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of incident role assignment from chat, and Teams-specific depth beyond channel creation.
